title: Syracuse VA EHRM Infrastructure Controls
scope: Complete 93-page visual review with bounded fan-coil/damper/fire-smoke/humidifier schedule context, BACnet interface requirements and explicit no-inference limits.
reading_notes: M-601/M-602 contain dense HVAC schedules including coil, chilled beam, pressure-relief/blast-suppression damper, humidifier and fire/smoke damper tables.
The record preserves literal rows and BACnet requirements without inventing final BAS topology.
verification_semantics: Every retained row/assertion is rechecked against MuPDF and Poppler; no physical takeoff is inferred.

requirement_audit.finding: Cover title identifies EHRM Infrastructure Upgrades—Syracuse VA.
All 93 pages have retained visual review; M-601/M-602/M-603 schedule/control sheets are explicitly reviewed.
No global scale or plan-derived quantity is asserted.
Three literal two-pipe fan-coil schedule rows are retained.
The fan-coil rows are coordinate-bounded and schedule titles retain cooling/heating, damper, humidifier and fire/smoke context.
One literal time-clock control-symbol row is retained with source-only ownership.
BACnet integration is published as an equipment requirement; final topology is not inferred.
Control-symbol schedule context is retained; no unstated sequence is invented.
BACnet/temperature/humidity interface requirement and controls-symbol context are retained without device counts.
Point, network, controller, wiring and physical-count limits are explicit.
Every page has a Poppler full-page review render.
All retained rows/assertions are rechecked with MuPDF and Poppler.
